subject.title: fix(telegram): recover when media downloads stall

question: Should Telegram retain the PR's single-owner retry model, where durable ingress replays failed media work but non-durable reply and album enrichment degrade after the first failed download?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but tests and CI cannot decide the intended delivery tradeoff between faster outer recovery and the previous immediate three-attempt download retry.

options.title: Keep single-owner retries
options.body: Accept durable spool replay for owned updates and immediate best-effort degradation for non-durable enrichment, then validate the exact merged head.

options.title: Restore bounded inner retries
options.body: Preserve immediate retries for non-durable media enrichment and add proof that compounded header deadlines remain acceptable.

recommendation.title: Keep single-owner retries
recommendation.body: Accept durable spool replay for owned updates and immediate best-effort degradation for non-durable enrichment, then validate the exact merged head.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the lifecycle rewrite, is assigned to the PR, and has the strongest evidence trail for the intended retry and cancellation ownership.
